capabilities: Downloads offline USGS topo and satellite map tiles with GPS position
Lists nearby water, medical, shelter and supply resources with distance and direction
Generates one note per local edible, toxic or medicinal plant species
Fetches weather alerts, forecasts and a local climate almanac
Writes survival guides, a pantry plan and a family emergency plan
extras: Core plugin is free; almanac, medicinal plants, pantry planner, map waypoints, printable maps and larger map downloads need a one-time $19 Pro license verified offline. USGS tiles and NWS weather cover the US only; the plant list is a memory aid, not an identification tool, and fungi appear only as a danger list.
problem: Obsidian holds notes but offers no way to gather offline, location-specific emergency reference material such as maps, water sources and local hazards.

relations.evidence: works with no signal, syncs with GSync, prints fine

summary: Location-based preparedness guide that generates offline topo maps, water sources, plant lists, weather alerts and survival notes in a vault.
